case.pattern_description: The transaction was an online card-not-present purchase executed from a new device profile with a proxy flag.
case.summary: Case HHG-008 has been confirmed as fraud with an exposure of $55.68 following a card-not-present transaction on a new device. Although the model assessed a high fraud probability of 0.95, the final verdict was driven primarily by the customer directly reporting the charge as unauthorized. Consequently, a case was automatically created and the compromised card was blocked by Level 1 support.

evidence.claim: Card ID resolved from case hint
Checked for similar past closed cases (0 found)
Device profile found for flagged transaction
Device profile shared by 350 cards — treated as a generic OS/browser/screen fingerprint, not a ring signal
Case written to graph as CASE-HHG-008

case.stop_reason: Customer's own unsolicited fraud report is decisive (Section 6).

sar.reason: No FILE_REPORT criteria met: exposure $55.68 does not exceed the $1,000 R2 threshold; no shared-device link was found (R6); pattern was not classified as undocumented (R9).

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer directly reported this transaction as unauthorized at intake (model-assessed probability was 0.95); the customer's own report takes precedence, and the case was confirmed as fraud.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer C13171 message: 'I never made this $55.68 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3558054.
